note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. The episode is copied to a neutral folder C:\lab\plNN so no user name shows in paths.

prepare: if (Test-Path C:\lab\pl03\api.pid) { Stop-Process -Id (Get-Content C:\lab\pl03\api.pid) -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item C:\lab\pl03\api.pid; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 }
Remove-Item C:\lab\pl03\api.log, C:\lab\pl03\api.err -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
# off-camera rehearsal: the Finance API hidden, one Ctrl+C run of the client (also the JIT warm-up demo.md asks for)

$bin = 'C:\lab\pl03\src\Contoso.Approvals.Api\bin\Debug\net10.0'; $p = Start-Process dotnet -ArgumentList "$bin\Contoso.Approvals.Api.dll", '--urls', 'http://localhost:5080' -WorkingDirectory $bin -RedirectStandardOutput C:\lab\pl03\api.log -RedirectStandardError C:\lab\pl03\api.err -WindowStyle Hidden -PassThru; $p.Id | Set-Content C:\lab\pl03\api.pid; Start-Sleep -Seconds 4
& ..\..\..\tools\rec\Send-CtrlC.ps1 -SelfTest

& ..\..\..\tools\rec\Send-CtrlC.ps1 -Rehearse -WorkingDirectory C:\lab\pl03 -AfterMs 3000 -Command 'dotnet run --no-build --project src\Contoso.Approvals.Cli -- sequential' -Expect 'Ctrl\+C: cancelling', 'Cancelled after' -Reject 'sequential: 12 requests'

Start-Sleep -Seconds 1; $ab = @(Select-String 'ABORTED by the client' C:\lab\pl03\api.log).Count; "rehearsal: the API logged $ab aborted call(s)"; if ($ab -lt 1) { throw 'rehearsal: the Ctrl+C reached no API call (it came before the batch started): raise -AfterMs in record.json' }
if (Test-Path C:\lab\pl03\api.pid) { Stop-Process -Id (Get-Content C:\lab\pl03\api.pid) -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item C:\lab\pl03\api.pid; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 }
& ..\..\..\tools\rec\Start-WtLayout.ps1 -Screen cancel
setup: Action 'prepare: series/programming-languages/episodes/03-async-await-patterns' (copy to C:\lab\pl03, dotnet build) if C:\lab\pl03 is gone

Action 'screen-prepare: series/programming-languages/episodes/03-async-await-patterns/cancel': runs the Ctrl+C self-test and one hidden rehearsal (action.last must say ok), then opens a Windows Terminal window 'api | MG pl03' / 'client | MG pl03' with two empty panes that wait for the take
Move the pointer off the window (other monitor)
steps: (take starts: window.json + window.go; the panes start by themselves when the recorder creates recordings\recording)

Nothing to click: left pane starts the API, right pane runs timeout, waitasync, then Send-CtrlC { ... sequential } (a real Ctrl+C after 3 s); the right pane creates recordings\stop at the end, which ends the take (about 40 s)

After the take: action 'screen-teardown: series/programming-languages/episodes/03-async-await-patterns/cancel' closes the panes and keeps their transcripts as screens\cancel.api.log / cancel.client.log

The operation has timed out.' and Aborted = 0; then 'Ctrl+C: cancelling...', 'Cancelled after N s.' and api saw ... Aborted = 2. Left: 'ABORTED by the client after 150 ms', then 'start' + 'done 300 ms' (the WaitAsync call kept running), then two 'ABORTED by the client' lines.
